question: Which district has the denser paved road network, Lindenmoor or Redfen, and by how many km of road per square kilometre?

result.final_text:
Redfen is denser: 0.070 km of road per square kilometre more than Lindenmoor (0.361 vs 0.396? Actually Lindenmoor = 402.3/1015.7 = 0.396; Redfen = 244.6/677.1 = 0.361, so Lindenmoor is denser by 0.035).  
ANSWER: Lindenmoor | 0.035
